passages.text: ## How to Run This Prompt Chain
This is a sequence of 5 simple prompts that should be run within the SAME chat. Simply go in order, 1 prompt a time.
Open the AI chat app you **use most frequently**: whether it’s ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok, Deepseek, etc.
You should open the app you ACTUALLY use because this exercise works best when AI has many past conversations to analyze.
> ***1. Based on everything you know about me, tell me who you think I’m pretending to be versus who I actually am.***
> ***5. Taking all this into consideration, what is the highest leverage thing I should do in the next 30 days?***
Think of it like asking your close friend their opinion of you. Your friend’s answer should be meaningful, valuable, and thought provoking… but **never 100% correct**.
The more history you have using the AI tool, the more CONTEXT it will have to give you a better answer.
